title: Decision Workbench
summary: A local-only worksheet that routes a real decision through PBHP and produces a downloadable draft receipt.
mechanism: The static browser tool applies conservative, explicit rules to the fields the user enters. It does not transmit data, certify correctness, or replace the responsible owner.
test_status: DOM, selector, JavaScript syntax, and receipt-output contracts pass; authenticated usability and accessibility QA remain open.
next_tests: Test edge cases and state persistence
